Trace, implement and test: leetcode69 sqrtx Newton method

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int mySqrt(int x) {
        const int eps = 1e-7;
        if (x == 0) return 0;
        double preX = 0; /* preX是区间的边界bound之一, 特定情况下preX和nextX(变量名末尾的X表示横坐标)可能会左右互换. 在区间[0, 1]上开始找，不断调整区间的边界 */
        double nextX = 1;
        while (nextX - preX > eps || preX - nextX > eps)
        {
            preX = nextX;
            nextX = (nextX + x / nextX) / 2.0;
        }
        return (int)nextX; // 转 int
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    int num = 666;
    auto res = sol.mySqrt(num);
    cout << res << endl;

    return 0;
}
